name: @intent-wallet/gas
description: Gas Abstraction & Smart-Account engine — the deterministic decision core for 'users shouldn't think about gas'. Decides gas SPONSORSHIP (bounded by a per-tx + per-user-per-day budget so a bug can't drain the paymaster), FEE-TOKEN selection (pay gas in USDC/any token, min-cost), BOUNDED gas params (never overpay during a fee spike), and smart-account BATCHING (fold N ops into one UserOperation). It DECIDES; it never signs or moves funds — the ERC-4337 UserOperation construction + paymaster signing is execution/infra. Deterministic (time injected) and offline-testable. Standalone.
